name: Consequences
overview: Scripture reveals that obedience to God's commandments brings exaltation and blessing, as seen in Deuteronomy 28:1, while sin results in separation from God, demonstrated in Isaiah 59:2. The heart's deceitfulness and wickedness, described in Jeremiah 17:9, leads to consequences that affect both individuals and their relationships. Proverbs emphasizes the importance of wise training and discipline to avoid shame and moral failure, highlighting that neglecting these responsibilities can produce corruption and distress.
